court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before C.V. Karthikeyan and K. Rajasekar, JJ.)
advocates: Mr. Krishnakumar, for M/s. Sarvabhauman Associates, for the Appellant(s);
Ms. D. Chitra Maragadham for Mr. T.R. Rajaraman, for the Respondent(s).
judgment_text:
Prayer : Appeal against the judgment and decree, dated 30.06.2010, passed in O.S.No.107 of 2008 on the file of Principal District Judge, Namakkal.

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

C.V. Karthikeyan, J.:— The property has already been sold by dividing the same into plots. The same had been recorded by this Court on 15-12-2025 as under:

“The learned counsel for the respondent had forwarded the details of the plots, which had been sold subsequent to the decree on 30-3-2012. By eight (8) separate documents of sale, the properties have been sub-divided into plots and have been sold. Subsequent to this, an order of stay had been granted on 1-11-2012.

2. The learned counsel for the respondents states that however even before the date, further sale conveyances had been taken place over the properties and possession has also been handed over.”

2. The suit had been filed, seeking specific performance, which was decreed. Defendants are in appeal.

3. The learned counsel for the respondent-plaintiff has categorically stated that the property is not available as on date.

4. The learned counsel for the appellants filed a memo stating that the appellants have taken change of vakalat.

5. Nothing survives in the appeal. Accordingly, this appeal Suit is dismissed. No costs.
